Name: Moody Farmer - Immersive Daily Mood System
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Moody Farmer[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Give your farmer a little personality — because not every day is a good day.[/i][/center]

[center]Ever wake up in Stardew Valley and think, [i]“I wonder what kind of mood my farmer is in today?”[/i][/center]

[center][b]Moody Farmer[/b] adds a daily mood system that gives your farmer a random mood each morning.[/center]
[center]Some days you’ll feel fantastic, some days you’ll want to stay in bed, and some days… you’d really rather not talk to anyone.[/center]
[center]Each mood comes with its own gameplay effect, and some negative moods can be overcome simply by changing how you spend your day.[/center]

[center]With [b]Version 4.0.0[/b], Moody Farmer introduces the [b]Positive Moods Expansion[/b], adding four new positive moods and a recovery rhythm where a bad day is followed by something better.[/center]

[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]



[code]😊  THE MOODS[/code][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52335/52335-1793849159-380647064.png[/img]
[code]Moody Farmer currently has 12 different moods your farmer can wake up with. Some are positive, some make the day a little harder, and others might change how you decide to spend your time.

Here's what each one does.

😊 Happy - Your farmer is having a good day. Nothing to complain about.

😐 Neutral - Just a normal day in the valley. Nothing particularly good or bad.

😢 Sad - Your farmer is feeling a bit down. Spending some time talking to villagers can help improve their mood.

😴 Bored - Maybe you've been doing the same things for too long. Visiting different areas around the valley can help with the boredom.

🛌 Lazy - Your farmer just doesn't feel like doing much today. Sometimes it's one of those days.

🙃 Antisocial - Not really in the mood for company. Talking to villagers will cost some stamina.

💜 Depression - If your farmer stays Sad without feeling better, things can get worse. This mood has some more serious consequences, which I'll explain below.

😰 Stressed - Your farmer is feeling overwhelmed. There are several ways to help them relax throughout the day.

New Positive Moods in Version 4.0.0

I've also added four more positive moods in version 4.0.0, giving your farmer a few more ways to feel good about the day.

🤩 Excited - Full of adrenaline and ready to get moving.

🔥 Motivated - Feeling productive and ready to get things done.

😏 Confident - Your farmer is feeling capable and ready to take on a fight.

🥰 Affectionate - Feeling a little more affectionate toward the people around them.[/code]

[code]🎨 MOOD ICONS[/code][code]I've kept the mood display fairly simple. You'll see a small icon above your stamina bar showing how your farmer is currently feeling.

Each mood has its own icon, so you can tell what's going on at a glance without having to open a menu.[/code]

[code]🔄 A BAD DAY, THEN A GOOD DAY[/code][code]I didn't want negative moods to become something you're constantly dealing with, especially when you've already had a difficult day.

So there's one rule I've added to balance things out.

**Whenever your farmer gets a negative mood, the following day is guaranteed to be Happy.**

That still applies even if you manage to overcome the negative mood before the day ends.

It's a simple way to make sure a bad day doesn't immediately turn into another one.[/code]

[code]💜 DEPRESSION[/code][code]Depression is a little different from the other moods.

If your farmer wakes up Sad and you don't manage to improve their mood during the day, that sadness can develop into Depression the following morning.

This comes with stronger penalties, along with two ghosts that start following your farmer around.

The ghosts will follow you indoors, outdoors, and between different locations. You can't kill them, and they'll damage your farmer if they manage to catch up.

You can hit them to make them teleport away temporarily, but they'll eventually come back.

They'll keep following you until you've dealt with the Depression mood.

It's meant to make this particular mood harder to ignore, rather than just being another stamina penalty.[/code]

[code]🚌 TAKING A BREAK[/code][code]I've added a way for your farmer to get away from everything when they're dealing with Depression.

While depressed, you can head to the **Bus Stop**, where you'll have the option to visit your hometown.

Taking that trip clears Depression completely, removes the ghosts, and lets your farmer return feeling better.

Sometimes getting away from the farm for a while is exactly what they need.[/code]

[code]🤯 STRESSED[/code][code]Stressed is one of the more involved moods I've added to Moody Farmer.

Your farmer can wake up feeling stressed, and rather than having one specific action that fixes it, there are several things you can do throughout the day to help them feel better.

Behind the scenes, the mod tracks a hidden **Relief** level.

I didn't want to add another progress bar or turn stress into a checklist of things you have to complete. Instead, you can just go about your day and naturally do things that help your farmer relax.

For example, you can:

- Talk to close friends or spend time with your spouse or partner.
- Interact with your pets.
- Go fishing or defeat some monsters.
- Spend a little time relaxing at the Stardrop Saloon.
- Head down to the Beach for a change of scenery.

As your farmer starts feeling better, you'll notice the Stressed mood icon gradually changing colour.

Red → Purple → Normal Skin Tone → Neutral

The colour gives you a rough idea of how stressed your farmer still is without needing to check any numbers.

Stress also affects a couple of everyday interactions.

When your farmer is highly stressed, tools that normally consume stamina will use a little more than usual. As you gradually relieve that stress, the additional stamina cost decreases until it's gone.

Your farmer can also become a little short-tempered when talking to villagers they aren't particularly close with, which may result in a small friendship penalty.

I wanted Stressed to affect gameplay without making it something you have to spend the entire day fixing.

**There's no additional punishment for going to bed while you're still Stressed.**

If you've managed to relax a little, great. If not, that's fine too.

Some days are just stressful, and I think that's enough.[/code]

[code]❤️ WHY MOODY FARMER?[/code][code]I wanted to give the farmer a little more personality beyond simply waking up with a full stamina bar and getting on with the day.

Some mornings they're in a great mood and ready to get things done. Other days they're bored, don't feel like talking to anyone, or would rather take it easy.

And occasionally, they might need a proper break from everything.

That's really the idea behind Moody Farmer. Your farmer has their own moods, and those moods can influence how the day plays out.

I didn't want every mood to become another task you have to manage. Sometimes it's just something you work around while playing Stardew Valley as you normally would.

I hope you enjoy Moody Farmer![/code]

💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
Moody Farmer is built around [b]Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems[/b] and does not depend on any other mod’s content.
Its mood mechanics use gameplay information already available through Stardew Valley, including NPC interactions, friendship, relationships, stamina use, fishing, combat, pets, and locations.
The mod does not generate, copy, rewrite, or redistribute NPC dialogue, portraits, sprites, schedules, character writing, or other NPC content.
It simply uses Stardew Valley’s existing gameplay information as part of its own predefined mood mechanics.
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development of Moody Farmer, including development of the mod’s code.
Some mood/UI icons were created with AI generation based on original concepts made specifically for Moody Farmer.
The mod itself was designed, tested, balanced, adjusted, and assembled by me.
[b]Moody Farmer does not use AI, an LLM, or any other generative system while Stardew Valley is running.[/b]
Daily moods are selected from a predefined set using the mod’s own programmed rules and randomisation. AI does not generate moods, NPC dialogue, character content, responses, or other gameplay content at runtime.
